commits.change: Single _pendingApproval routing slot replaced with an arrival-ordered pending Queue<ApprovalGateView> (bound 8; overflow auto-denies the oldest gate so its DecisionRecorded waiter always wakes). DrainGateQueue now appends every queued gate and enqueues it; TryRouteApprovalKey/TryRouteApprovalClick serve the OLDEST pending gate and dequeue it on decision; resolved-off-path gates are pruned before routing. ApprovalGateView.Id is now instance-unique (approval:{n}:{toolName}) — the old approval:{toolName} collided for same-tool gates.
commits.tests: Harbor.Tui.ConsoleEx.Tests 661/661 pass; temp acceptance harness (2 consecutive bash gates accepted in arrival order, no zombie IsPending, ids distinct; overflow auto-deny) 2/2 pass, harness removed before commit.

commits.change: ScreenBuffer.SetStyleAt skipped Wide lead cells (returned false), so PanelFx.BlendRegion left wide glyphs stale-colored and could half-recolor a pair via its WSkip tail. Writes now restyle the full lead+tail cluster and route tail hits to their lead; tail cells are rebuilt with Cell.From(Rune(0)) which resolves to WSkip width. VirtualizedChatTimeline.Append's per-append O(n) budget rescan replaced with a running total (adjusted on Append/ReplaceLast/Replace/Evict); eviction now triggers only when the total crosses BudgetBytes and evicts down to a 75% low-water mark in one pass instead of evicting every append.
commits.tests: Harbor.Tui.ConsoleEx.Tests 661/661 pass (incl. DiffEngine style-only and golden SGR tests, Budget eviction test); temp harness verified lead+tail restyle, tail routing, no stale colors after BlendRegion, and 20k appends with eviction complete in tens of ms — harness removed before commit.

commits.change: RunAsync finally awaited backend.WriteAsync(leave-alt-screen) BEFORE modeController.Restore(); a throwing write skipped Restore and left Windows consoles in raw/VT mode. The write is now wrapped in try/catch (logged via ILogger, no silent swallow) so Restore() runs unconditionally; Unix path and public API unchanged, no hot-path allocations.
commits.tests: Harbor.Tui.ConsoleEx.PtyTests 39/39 pass (one transient flake on first run — passed on two consecutive re-runs); Harbor.App.Cli.Tests 78/78 pass.

verification.independent_recheck: All three commits re-verified post-hoc: full Harbor.slnx Release build 0 errors / 180 warnings (pre-existing, none in the five touched files); Harbor.Tui.ConsoleEx.Tests 661/661, Harbor.Tui.ConsoleEx.PtyTests 39/39 (×2 after one transient flake), Harbor.App.Cli.Tests 78/78.
verification.pty_flake: PtyTests first invocation had 1/39 failure with no reproduction on two full re-runs — treat as environment-flaky, not a regression from 52f0712.

notes: Hard rule '1-2 files per commit' held: 2/2/1 files; three atomic commits (task 2's named files both fit in one).
Harbor.DesignSystem untouched; no public API changes; no TODO(principles) markers added.

Eviction Array.Copy inside TimelineLayoutCache.EvictFirst remains O(n) per single eviction; low-water batching amortizes it in practice (rare pass, memmove-speed). A bulk prefix-remove EvictFirst(count) in the cache would make it strictly O(1) amortized per append — deferred as future work to keep this commit within the file budget.
Full Harbor.slnx build after all commits: 0 errors, 180 warnings (all pre-existing, none from touched files).
